title: Capture signed-app install custody
objective: Close the intended-device helper and protected signed-app install execution boundary, including replacement-blind exact-Git helper custody, ACL stripping/rejection, and accepted-runner byte custody, then hand one clean exact descendant to flagship composition.

blockers.reason: Canonical #2789 is clean at exact 02d6cb648e2506aee1ea69096c1e6a0b7038d9c1 after #2863 removed the two historical ACL materializer artifacts. Permanent installer still retains exact-Git private-device runner execution, `ditto --noacl`, and root-side BSD ACL fail-closed rejection. Fresh Capture Signed App Install Custody, Field Build Provenance, Main Selective Graft, and Xcode exact-head runs are currently queued on 02d6cb648; queued is not green and ancestor evidence does not accept this head.

Independent review found the later signed-app custody helper had weaker Git authority than the intended-device runner: ordinary `git rev-parse "$SOURCE_SHA:$SIGNED_APP_CUSTODY_HELPER_PATH"` and `git cat-file blob` can follow repository-local replace refs. #2871 is the correct repair family and makes both helper object reads replacement-blind/config-isolated with GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; the permanent signed-install regression is strengthened accordingly. However #2871 actual live head is ad5e83d2ac6c6a44678d4da5e9580f7d09ed5a9c, not the body-advertised a47ec1fa, and exact compare from canonical #2789 currently contains THREE files including worker-only `.github/workflows/tmp-v14-signed-acl-permanent-macos-c7e19a.yml`. Therefore the replacement-blind two-line product delta is valid ingredient work but this exact head is not clean/acceptable. Require the temporary Mac materializer to finish or be removed, leave only permanent installer+regression bytes, deliberately compose into canonical #2789, then rerun Signed App Install Custody including real macOS transport/ACL evidence plus Field/Graft/Xcode on the moved exact canonical head.
